baseline-pg2.name: baseline-pg2
baseline-pg2.policy: Deny one tool call when PromptGuard 2 malicious probability is at least 0.5. Check the first user prompt before inference and each complete model response containing tool calls. Return PG2_PROMPT_ATTACK only to the encrypted user session. Continue the job.
